-- Spec for appending a copy of s to the borrowed list dst.
-- add_name has no ex line: its effect is on dst, and an ex line needs a value to compare.
-- The pure helper added() carries the examples that pin down the intended result.

added(xs: List[str], s: str) -> List[str] =
  post out.len() == xs.len() + 1
  ex added([], "a") == ["a"]
  ex added(["x"], "y") == ["x", "y"]
  var out: List[str] = []
  for x in xs
    out.append(copy x)
  out.append(copy s)
  out

add_name(var dst: List[str], s: str) =
  pre s.char_count() >= 0
  post dst.len() >= 1
  dst.append(copy s)
